Moment_captions.HAVING_COFFEE: A slow coffee and a quiet moment are my favorite ways to start the day.
Moment_captions.WALKING_MY_DOG: My dog keeps me active, outdoors, and probably happier than I deserve.
Moment_captions.WORKING_OUT_AT_THE_GYM: I like staying active and making time to feel strong and healthy.
Moment_captions.COOKING_DINNER: I enjoy cooking at home, experimenting with new recipes, and making something from scratch.
Moment_captions.BAKING: Baking is my favorite excuse to slow down and make something delicious.
Moment_captions.READING_A_BOOK: Give me a good book, a quiet place, and I can disappear for hours.
Moment_captions.WATCHING_A_VOLUME: A good movie, some snacks, and a relaxed evening is hard to beat.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_VIDEO_GAMES: I enjoy getting lost in a good game when I have some time to myself.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_BOARD_GAMES: I love a little competition, especially when good friends are involved.
Moment_captions.OUT_WITH_FRIENDS: Some of my best moments are simple evenings spent laughing with good friends.
Moment_captions.HAVING_BRUNCH: Good food, good coffee, and nowhere to rush to — that's my kind of weekend.
Moment_captions.DINING_OUT: I enjoy discovering new places, trying different food, and finding hidden gems.
Moment_captions.HIKING: I feel happiest outdoors, exploring new trails and getting away from the usual routine.
Moment_captions.GOING_FOR_A_RUN: Running helps me clear my head, stay active, and enjoy some time outside.
Moment_captions.CYCLING: I love getting on my bike, exploring new places, and enjoying the ride.
Moment_captions.AT_THE_BEACH: Give me some sunshine, the sea, and a little free time and I'm happy.
Moment_captions.WATCHING_THE_SUNSET: I never get tired of stopping for a beautiful sunset, wherever I happen to be.
Moment_captions.ON_VACATION: I love discovering new places, trying new things, and making memories along the way.
Moment_captions.ROAD_TRIP: Good music, open roads, interesting stops, and no strict plans — my kind of adventure.
Moment_captions.CAMPING: Getting away from the noise and spending time outdoors is something I really enjoy.
Moment_captions.TAKING_PHOTOS: I enjoy noticing the little moments and capturing the ones worth remembering.
Moment_captions.MAKING_ART: Creating something with my own hands is one of my favorite ways to relax.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_MUSIC: Music has always been part of my life, whether I'm listening or playing.
Moment_captions.DANCING: I love good music, good energy, and having an excuse to dance.
Moment_captions.SHOPPING: I enjoy exploring new places, finding interesting things, and occasionally treating myself.
Moment_captions.VOLUNTEERING: I like spending some of my time doing something useful for other people.
Moment_captions.STUDYING: I'm always working toward something new and enjoy learning along the way.
Moment_captions.WORKING: I'm ambitious about what I do, but I also believe life should be more than work.
Moment_captions.RELAXING_AT_HOME: Sometimes my ideal evening is simply staying home, switching off, and enjoying some quiet time.
Moment_captions.TRYING_SOMETHING_NEW: I like keeping life interesting and saying yes to experiences I haven't tried before.

Rules.title: Nneyɛe ho mmara
Rules.subtitle: Yɛsrɛ wo gye yɛn community mmara tom ansa na woahwehwɛ matches.
Rules.respect_title: Yɛ ayamye na di afoforo ni
Rules.respect_desc: Harassment, hate speech, ahunahuna anaa suban bɔne bɛma wɔabara wo daa ntɛm ara.
Rules.media_desc: Moment biara a wokyɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɛwɔ wo ankasa mfonini anaa video tiawa. Nokwareyɛ ne nea ɛma platform yi da nsow.
Rules.moment_desc: Wubetumi ayɛ public moments anaa match-only moments, nanso sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosoma match request a, ɛsɛ sɛ wowɔ public moment baako.
Rules.safety_desc: Nkyɛ wo password, bank nsɛm, anaa fie address ne nnipa a woahyia wɔn foforo no.
